description: Open-source desktop chart app (Rust + Tauri). Indicators are sandboxed WebAssembly components written with the sandchart-indicator Rust SDK and built and tested with the sandchart-indicator CLI.
rules: An indicator is a WebAssembly component that exports sandchart:indicator/indicator@0.1.0 and imports only WASI 0.2. Build it for the wasm32-wasip2 target.
Start a new indicator with `sandchart-indicator new <name>`, build with `sandchart-indicator build`, and check it with `sandchart-indicator test <file.wasm>`; fix every warning, including repaints.
Implement the `Indicator` trait (`meta()` and `compute(params, candles)`) and export it with `sandchart_indicator::export!(MyIndicator with_types_in sandchart_indicator::bindings)`.
`compute` is a pure function over all candles, oldest first; never read bars after the one being computed.
Line and Histogram series return exactly one value per candle; use NaN where there is no value.
Read parameters through `Params::new(params)` and its `int`, `float`, `boolean` and `choice` getters; use the helpers in `sandchart_indicator::ta` (sma, ema, rma, stdev, highest, lowest).
Series colours are palette slots 0 to 7, never RGB values. A Markers series must be on Pane::Price; Band(a, b) names two Line series of the same module on the same pane.
Indicators have no files, network, environment or real clock; use the candle `time` field (Unix milliseconds) for time.
